verdict.rationale: The official exa-js SDK documents a single call, `exa.answer("...")`, under the heading "Get answers with citations" [exa-gh-8, exa-gh-3]. This directly matches the story. Docs also describe grounded synthesis and web-cited results through Exa Agent [exa-docs-25, exa-docs-26], and streaming search that yields OpenAI-style chat completion chunks [exa-gh-2]. Missing for 10: a first-party API reference for the answer endpoint showing the citation/source format and options, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the answer feature works as described.
